_meta.description: Profils de balance, stat templates et scaling pour familiers. 100% serveur-autoritaire.
_meta.rule: Un familier doit complementer le joueur, pas le remplacer. Combat plus lent attendu (familier filler avec basic attack entre cooldowns).
_meta.level_cap_to_owner: Le niveau du familier est cape au niveau du proprietaire.

pet_companion_v1.description_fr: Profil par defaut V1 : compagnon equilibre, level capped au joueur, degats reduits pour ne pas trivialiser le combat.
pet_companion_v1.description_en: Default V1 profile: balanced companion, level capped to owner, reduced damage to avoid trivializing combat.

slot_progression.description_fr: Nombre de slots de skills disponibles selon le niveau du familier. Slots non-rerollable individuellement, rerollable globalement via item.
slot_progression.description_en: Number of skill slots available based on pet level. Slots not individually rerollable, globally rerollable via item.

pet_attack_v1.description_fr: Rat d'attaque. Hauts degats physiques, faible HP/DEF.
pet_attack_v1.description_en: Attack rat. High physical damage, low HP/DEF.

pet_tank_v1.description_fr: Rat tank. Hauts HP/DEF/armure, bas degats.
pet_tank_v1.description_en: Tank rat. High HP/DEF/armor, low damage.

pet_heal_v1.description_fr: Rat soigneur. Haute MAG, faible HP/ATK. Squishy = positionnement compte.
pet_heal_v1.description_en: Healer rat. High MAG, low HP/ATK. Squishy = positioning matters.

pet_utility_v1.description_fr: Rat utilitaire. Stats equilibrees, hauts crit/effect_chance.
pet_utility_v1.description_en: Utility rat. Balanced stats, high crit/effect_chance.

pet_attack_v1.description_fr: Cible les ennemis les plus fragiles, casts agressifs.
pet_attack_v1.description_en: Targets the most fragile enemies, aggressive casts.

pet_tank_v1.description_fr: Front line, taunt sur cooldown, protege le proprietaire.
pet_tank_v1.description_en: Front line, taunt on cooldown, protects the owner.

pet_heal_v1.description_fr: Cible l'allie au plus bas HP, conserve son Souffle.
pet_heal_v1.description_en: Targets the lowest HP ally, conserves Breath.

pet_utility_v1.description_fr: Buff allies / debuff ennemis selon contexte, equilibre.
pet_utility_v1.description_en: Buffs allies / debuffs enemies based on context, balanced.
